title: DOGE Officially Shutters July 4 — Leaves $11 Billion Hole and 300K Lost Federal Jobs
synopsis: The Department of Government Efficiency, co-led by Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy, officially ceased operations July 4, 2026 as mandated by Trump's January 2025 executive order. It left an estimated $11 billion hole in the federal budget paid to workers who accepted Musk's "Fork in the Road" offer to do nothing for nine months while being paid full salary. Agencies immediately began rehiring, with over 104,000 new job postings in early 2026.
